name: free-crm
description: A private, open-source CRM operating system for solopreneurs, backed by durable cloud data and document storage.

scripts.device: npm run build && npm run db:local:migrate && wrangler dev -c dist/server/wrangler.json --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 3477 --persist-to .wrangler/state --var FREE_CRM_LOCAL_MODE:true
scripts.lint: eslint app lib server workers db tests proxy.ts vite.config.ts next.config.ts drizzle.config.ts vitest.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.db:local:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local -c wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:cloud:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:d1-rpc:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c wrangler.d1-rpc.user.jsonc
scripts.check: npm run security:secrets && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run agent:safety && npm run test:db && npm run db:check && npm run db:drift && npm run build

DB.description: Your private D1 relational database for CRM records, audit history, workflows, and reports.

FILES.description: Your private R2 bucket for workspace-prefixed documents. Do not enable public bucket access.

FREE_CRM_AUTH_MODE.description: Keep `locked` for the protected first install. Activate exact-owner Cloudflare Access only after the sealed deployment succeeds.

FREE_CRM_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your non-secret Cloudflare Access team domain, configured during private activation.

FREE_CRM_ACCESS_AUD.description: The non-secret audience of the exact Worker Access application.

FREE_CRM_OWNER_EMAIL.description: The one owner email accepted after Access JWT verification.
